questions.stem: Which of the following would reduce the rate of heat conduction through a wall?

options.text: Using a material with higher thermal conductivity
Increasing the temperature difference across the wall
Using a thicker wall made of a material with low thermal conductivity

questions.explanation: The rate of conduction depends on thickness, cross-sectional area, thermal conductivity, and temperature difference. A thicker wall and a material with lower thermal conductivity both reduce the rate of heat transfer.
